summary_en: This Phase 3 study tests intravesical nadofaragene firadenovec alone or followed by intravesical gemcitabine and docetaxel in people with high-grade, BCG-unresponsive non-muscle invasive bladder cancer with carcinoma in situ. The record says the pembrolizumab arm has closed, so the study now has two arms with 1:1 randomization. The drugs are given into the bladder, and the dose schedule and how often they are given are not stated. The main outcome measure is not stated in this record, and the study is Phase 3.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 3 evalúa nadofaragene firadenovec intravesical solo o seguido de gemcitabina y docetaxel intravesicales en personas con cáncer de vejiga no músculo-invasivo de alto grado, resistente a BCG, con carcinoma in situ. El registro indica que el brazo de pembrolizumab se cerró, por lo que el estudio ahora tiene dos brazos con aleatorización 1:1. Los medicamentos se administran dentro de la vejiga, y el esquema de dosis y la frecuencia no están indicados. La medida de resultado principal no se indica en este registro, y el estudio es de fase 3.
who_for: Carcinoma in situ, with or without high-grade Ta/T1 bladder cancer.
Bladder cancer that did not respond to, or came back after, at least 2 courses of BCG within 12 months.
ECOG performance status of 2 or lower, and age 18 or older.
Life expectancy longer than 2 years, in the investigator's opinion.
Participants who choose not to have a cystectomy.
not_for: Muscle-invasive or metastatic disease shown at screening.
Upper tract urothelial carcinoma or urothelial carcinoma in the prostatic urethra.
Prior treatment with nadofaragene firadenovec at any time.
Prior systemic therapy for bladder cancer, or prior intravesical chemotherapy for BCG-unresponsive disease.
Pelvic external beam radiotherapy within 2 years, or investigational drug use within 1 month before screening.
